sentences.text: Les enfants de l'école viennent dévorer les croissants d'Antoine à la récré.
sentences.en: The schoolchildren come to devour Antoine's croissants at break time.
sentences.ko: 학교 아이들이 쉬는 시간마다 앙투안의 크루아상을 먹어 치우러 와요.

sentences.text: Sarah semble dévorer les livres sur les peintres impressionnistes.
sentences.en: Sarah seems to devour books on the Impressionist painters.
sentences.ko: 사라는 인상파 화가에 관한 책을 탐독하는 것 같아요.

sentences.text: Le samedi, Antoine prépare une tarte aux champignons et au fromage.
sentences.en: On Saturdays, Antoine makes a mushroom and cheese tart.
sentences.ko: 토요일마다 앙투안은 버섯 치즈 타르트를 만들어요.

sentences.text: Pour la nature morte, Sarah dessine un panier de champignons des bois.
sentences.en: For the still life, Sarah draws a basket of wild mushrooms.
sentences.ko: 정물화 시간에 사라는 숲버섯 바구니를 그려요.

sentences.text: Antoine met des éclats de cacahuète sur ses cookies au chocolat.
sentences.en: Antoine puts peanut pieces on his chocolate cookies.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 초콜릿 쿠키 위에 땅콩 조각을 올려요.

sentences.text: Sarah grignote une cacahuète entre deux coups de pinceau.
sentences.en: Sarah nibbles a peanut between two brushstrokes.
sentences.ko: 사라는 붓질 사이사이 땅콩을 하나씩 집어 먹어요.

sentences.text: Antoine essuie la graisse du four à la fin de chaque journée.
sentences.en: Antoine wipes the grease off the oven at the end of every day.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 하루가 끝날 때마다 오븐의 기름때를 닦아요.

sentences.text: La prof explique à Sarah que la peinture à l'huile contient une sorte de graisse.
sentences.en: The teacher explains to Sarah that oil paint contains a kind of fat.
sentences.ko: 선생님이 사라에게 유화 물감에는 일종의 기름이 들어 있다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Pour midi, Antoine vend aussi des sandwichs au pâté de campagne.
sentences.en: For lunch, Antoine also sells sandwiches with country pâté.
sentences.ko: 점심에 앙투안은 시골풍 파테 샌드위치도 팔아요.

sentences.text: Sarah a fait un vrai pâté d'encre sur son dessin.
sentences.en: Sarah made a real ink blot on her drawing.
sentences.ko: 사라는 그림에 잉크 얼룩을 크게 남겼어요.

sentences.text: Antoine ajoute des raisins secs dans sa brioche du dimanche.
sentences.en: Antoine adds raisins to his Sunday brioche.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 일요일 브리오슈에 건포도를 넣어요.

sentences.text: Sarah peint une grappe de raisin dans une coupe en verre.
sentences.en: Sarah paints a bunch of grapes in a glass bowl.
sentences.ko: 사라는 유리 그릇에 담긴 포도 한 송이를 그려요.

sentences.text: Un client demande à Antoine s'il peut faire un feuilleté aux crevettes pour Noël.
sentences.en: A customer asks Antoine if he can make a shrimp puff pastry for Christmas.
sentences.ko: 한 손님이 앙투안에게 크리스마스용 새우 파이를 만들 수 있는지 물어요.

sentences.text: Sarah mélange le rose et l'orange pour obtenir la couleur d'une crevette.
sentences.en: Sarah mixes pink and orange to get the colour of a shrimp.
sentences.ko: 사라는 분홍과 주황을 섞어 새우 색을 만들어요.

sentences.text: Pendant le carnaval, Antoine fait frire des centaines de beignets.
sentences.en: During carnival, Antoine fries hundreds of doughnuts.
sentences.ko: 카니발 기간에 앙투안은 도넛을 수백 개 튀겨요.

sentences.text: Après le cours, Sarah partage un beignet avec son voisin de chevalet.
sentences.en: After class, Sarah shares a doughnut with the person at the next easel.
sentences.ko: 수업 후 사라는 옆 이젤 사람과 도넛을 나눠 먹어요.

sentences.text: Antoine ne garde jamais ses fruits trop longtemps pour ne pas les laisser pourrir.
sentences.en: Antoine never keeps his fruit too long so as not to let it rot.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 과일이 썩지 않도록 절대 오래 두지 않아요.

sentences.text: La prof dit à Sarah de ne pas laisser les fruits du modèle pourrir sur la table.
sentences.en: The teacher tells Sarah not to let the model fruit rot on the table.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 사라에게 그림용 과일이 탁자 위에서 썩지 않게 하라고 해요.

sentences.text: Le pain aux olives d'Antoine part en moins d'une heure.
sentences.en: Antoine's olive bread sells out in under an hour.
sentences.ko: 앙투안의 올리브 빵은 한 시간도 안 돼 다 팔려요.

sentences.text: Sarah choisit un vert olive pour le fond de son tableau.
sentences.en: Sarah chooses an olive green for the background of her painting.
sentences.ko: 사라는 그림 배경으로 올리브색을 골라요.

sentences.text: Antoine nappe ses tartelettes aux fraises d'une fine couche de gelée.
sentences.en: Antoine glazes his strawberry tartlets with a thin layer of jelly.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 딸기 타르트에 젤리를 얇게 입혀요.

sentences.text: Sarah peint un paysage d'hiver couvert de gelée blanche.
sentences.en: Sarah paints a winter landscape covered in hoarfrost.
sentences.ko: 사라는 서리로 덮인 겨울 풍경을 그려요.

sentences.text: Antoine vend des bonbons en paille à côté de la caisse, pour les enfants.
sentences.en: Antoine sells sweets in straws next to the till, for the kids.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 계산대 옆에서 아이들을 위해 빨대 사탕을 팔아요.

sentences.text: Sarah porte un chapeau de paille pour peindre dehors au soleil.
sentences.en: Sarah wears a straw hat to paint outside in the sun.
sentences.ko: 사라는 햇볕 아래 밖에서 그림을 그리려고 밀짚모자를 써요.

sentences.text: Antoine fait attention à l'alimentation de ses clients diabétiques.
sentences.en: Antoine pays attention to the diet of his diabetic customers.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 당뇨가 있는 손님들의 식단을 신경 써요.

sentences.text: L'atelier de Sarah expose des affiches sur l'alimentation dans l'art ancien.
sentences.en: Sarah's studio displays posters about food in ancient art.
sentences.ko: 사라의 화실에는 옛 미술 속 음식에 관한 포스터가 걸려 있어요.

sentences.text: Le jambon-beurre reste le sandwich le plus vendu chez Antoine.
sentences.en: The ham and butter sandwich is still the best-selling sandwich at Antoine's.
sentences.ko: 잠봉뵈르는 여전히 앙투안 가게에서 가장 많이 팔리는 샌드위치예요.

sentences.text: Sarah apporte un sandwich au jambon pour l'atelier du samedi.
sentences.en: Sarah brings a ham sandwich to the Saturday workshop.
sentences.ko: 사라는 토요일 실습에 햄 샌드위치를 싸 와요.

sentences.text: Antoine fait bouillir le lait avant de préparer la crème pâtissière.
sentences.en: Antoine boils the milk before making the pastry cream.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 커스터드 크림을 만들기 전에 우유를 끓여요.

sentences.text: La prof montre à Sarah comment faire bouillir de la colle de peau.
sentences.en: The teacher shows Sarah how to boil hide glue.
sentences.ko: 선생님이 사라에게 아교를 끓이는 법을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: À midi, Antoine mange une soupe de nouilles achetée au restaurant d'en face.
sentences.en: At noon, Antoine eats a noodle soup bought from the restaurant opposite.
sentences.ko: 점심에 앙투안은 맞은편 식당에서 산 국수를 먹어요.

sentences.text: Pour un collage, Sarah colle des nouilles sèches sur un carton peint.
sentences.en: For a collage, Sarah glues dried noodles onto painted cardboard.
sentences.ko: 콜라주 시간에 사라는 색칠한 판지에 마른 국수를 붙여요.

sentences.text: Pour fêter la nouvelle boulangerie, Antoine fait sauter le bouchon d'une bouteille de cidre.
sentences.en: To celebrate the new bakery, Antoine pops the cork on a bottle of cider.
sentences.ko: 새 빵집 개업을 축하하며 앙투안은 사과주 병마개를 터뜨려요.

sentences.text: Sarah n'arrive pas à enlever le bouchon de son tube de peinture.
sentences.en: Sarah can't get the cap off her tube of paint.
sentences.ko: 사라는 물감 튜브 뚜껑을 열지 못해요.

sentences.text: Antoine sort la première fournée de baguettes à six heures du matin.
sentences.en: Antoine takes out the first batch of baguettes at six in the morning.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 아침 여섯 시에 첫 바게트를 꺼내요.

sentences.text: La prof de Sarah dirige le cours comme un chef d'orchestre avec sa baguette.
sentences.en: Sarah's teacher leads the class like a conductor with her baton.
sentences.ko: 사라의 선생님은 지휘봉을 든 지휘자처럼 수업을 이끌어요.

sentences.text: En juin, Antoine prépare des clafoutis avec les cerises de son jardin.
sentences.en: In June, Antoine makes clafoutis with the cherries from his garden.
sentences.ko: 유월이면 앙투안은 자기 정원의 체리로 클라푸티를 만들어요.

sentences.text: Sarah ajoute une cerise rouge vif au sommet de son gâteau en pâte à modeler.
sentences.en: Sarah adds a bright red cherry to the top of her modelling-clay cake.
sentences.ko: 사라는 찰흙 케이크 꼭대기에 새빨간 체리를 올려요.

sentences.text: Avant d'être boulanger, Antoine était cuisinier dans un grand hôtel.
sentences.en: Before becoming a baker, Antoine was a cook in a big hotel.
sentences.ko: 제빵사가 되기 전에 앙투안은 큰 호텔의 요리사였어요.

sentences.text: Le modèle du jour est un ancien cuisinier qui pose avec sa toque.
sentences.en: Today's model is a former cook posing in his chef's hat.
sentences.ko: 오늘의 모델은 요리사 모자를 쓰고 포즈를 취한 전직 요리사예요.

sentences.text: Antoine trouve le chocolat noir de son fournisseur un peu trop amer.
sentences.en: Antoine finds his supplier's dark chocolate a bit too bitter.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 납품받는 다크 초콜릿이 좀 너무 쓰다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Sarah a un goût amer dans la bouche après les critiques de la prof.
sentences.en: Sarah has a bitter taste in her mouth after the teacher's criticism.
sentences.ko: 선생님의 비평을 듣고 사라는 입맛이 씁쓸해요.

sentences.text: Le voisin pêcheur offre parfois un crabe à Antoine contre une miche de pain.
sentences.en: The neighbouring fisherman sometimes gives Antoine a crab in exchange for a loaf.
sentences.ko: 이웃 어부는 가끔 빵 한 덩이를 받고 앙투안에게 게를 줘요.

sentences.text: Sarah a choisi de peindre un crabe sur un rocher pour son examen.
sentences.en: Sarah chose to paint a crab on a rock for her exam.
sentences.ko: 사라는 시험 작품으로 바위 위의 게를 그리기로 했어요.

sentences.text: La mousse au chocolat d'Antoine est célèbre dans tout le quartier.
sentences.en: Antoine's chocolate mousse is famous throughout the neighbourhood.
sentences.ko: 앙투안의 초콜릿 무스는 온 동네에서 유명해요.

sentences.text: Sarah peint les vieux murs couverts de mousse du jardin de l'atelier.
sentences.en: Sarah paints the old moss-covered walls of the studio garden.
sentences.ko: 사라는 화실 정원의 이끼 낀 오래된 담장을 그려요.

sentences.text: Antoine apprend à son apprenti à mélanger la farine sans faire de grumeaux.
sentences.en: Antoine teaches his apprentice to mix the flour without making lumps.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 견습생에게 덩어리 없이 밀가루를 섞는 법을 가르쳐요.

sentences.text: La prof conseille à Sarah de mélanger moins de blanc dans ses ombres.
sentences.en: The teacher advises Sarah to mix less white into her shadows.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 사라에게 그림자에 흰색을 덜 섞으라고 조언해요.

sentences.text: Antoine refuse de maquiller un gâteau raté avec trop de sucre glace.
sentences.en: Antoine refuses to disguise a failed cake with too much icing sugar.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 망친 케이크를 슈거 파우더로 덮어 감추지 않아요.

sentences.text: Pour le spectacle de l'école, Sarah aide à maquiller les petits en animaux.
sentences.en: For the school show, Sarah helps make up the little ones as animals.
sentences.ko: 학교 공연 때 사라는 아이들을 동물 분장시키는 걸 도와요.

sentences.text: Antoine doit alimenter le four à bois toute la nuit.
sentences.en: Antoine has to keep feeding the wood-fired oven all night.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 밤새 장작 오븐에 불을 지펴야 해요.

sentences.text: La vente des tableaux de la classe va alimenter la caisse pour la sortie au musée.
sentences.en: The sale of the class paintings will fund the museum trip.
sentences.ko: 반 그림 판매 수익은 미술관 견학 비용으로 쓰일 거예요.

sentences.text: Le livreur a abîmé une caisse d'œufs en la déposant chez Antoine.
sentences.en: The delivery man damaged a crate of eggs when dropping it off at Antoine's.
sentences.ko: 배달원이 앙투안 가게에 달걀 상자를 내려놓다가 상하게 했어요.

sentences.text: Sarah a peur d'abîmer ses pinceaux neufs avec l'acrylique.
sentences.en: Sarah is afraid of ruining her new brushes with acrylic paint.
sentences.ko: 사라는 아크릴 물감 때문에 새 붓이 상할까 봐 걱정해요.

sentences.text: Antoine trouve ignoble de vendre du pain de la veille comme s'il était frais.
sentences.en: Antoine finds it disgraceful to sell yesterday's bread as if it were fresh.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 어제 빵을 갓 구운 것처럼 파는 건 비열하다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Un visiteur a fait un commentaire ignoble sur le tableau de Sarah.
sentences.en: A visitor made a vile comment about Sarah's painting.
sentences.ko: 한 관람객이 사라의 그림에 아주 고약한 말을 했어요.

sentences.text: Antoine sait que son voisin pâtissier est très susceptible, alors il ne critique jamais ses gâteaux.
sentences.en: Antoine knows his pastry-chef neighbour is very touchy, so he never criticises his cakes.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 이웃 제과사가 아주 예민하다는 걸 알아서 그 케이크를 절대 흉보지 않아요.

sentences.text: Sarah est un peu susceptible quand on touche à ses dessins.
sentences.en: Sarah is a bit touchy when people touch her drawings.
sentences.ko: 사라는 누가 자기 그림에 손대면 좀 예민해져요.

sentences.text: Le dimanche matin, les clients se bousculent devant la vitrine d'Antoine.
sentences.en: On Sunday mornings, customers jostle in front of Antoine's window.
sentences.ko: 일요일 아침이면 손님들이 앙투안 가게 진열창 앞에서 북적여요.

sentences.text: Un élève pressé a bousculé le chevalet de Sarah en passant.
sentences.en: A student in a hurry knocked into Sarah's easel as he went by.
sentences.ko: 서두르던 학생이 지나가다 사라의 이젤을 밀쳤어요.

sentences.text: Pour le mariage, Antoine a monté une pièce montée d'une taille monstrueuse.
sentences.en: For the wedding, Antoine built a tiered cake of monstrous size.
sentences.ko: 결혼식을 위해 앙투안은 어마어마한 크기의 웨딩 케이크를 쌓았어요.

sentences.text: Sarah dessine un dragon monstrueux pour le concours de bande dessinée.
sentences.en: Sarah draws a monstrous dragon for the comic contest.
sentences.ko: 사라는 만화 대회에 낼 거대한 괴물 용을 그려요.

sentences.text: Le prix du beurre est devenu excessif, se plaint Antoine.
sentences.en: The price of butter has become excessive, Antoine complains.
sentences.ko: 버터 값이 지나치게 올랐다고 앙투안이 불평해요.

sentences.text: La prof trouve que Sarah utilise un rouge excessif dans son portrait.
sentences.en: The teacher thinks Sarah uses too much red in her portrait.
sentences.ko: 선생님은 사라가 초상화에 빨간색을 지나치게 쓴다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Pour Antoine, servir un client sans dire bonjour est inacceptable.
sentences.en: For Antoine, serving a customer without saying hello is unacceptable.
sentences.ko: 앙투안에게 인사도 없이 손님을 맞는 건 있을 수 없는 일이에요.

sentences.text: Pour la prof, rendre un dessin copié sur internet est inacceptable, rappelle-t-elle à Sarah.
sentences.en: For the teacher, handing in a drawing copied from the internet is unacceptable, she reminds Sarah.
sentences.ko: 인터넷에서 베낀 그림을 내는 건 용납할 수 없다고 선생님이 사라에게 다시 말해요.

sentences.text: Antoine regarde d'un air détaché le concurrent qui ouvre en face.
sentences.en: Antoine looks on with a detached air at the competitor opening across the street.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 맞은편에 문을 연 경쟁 가게를 무심하게 바라봐요.

sentences.text: Sarah peint un visage au regard détaché, presque absent.
sentences.en: Sarah paints a face with a detached, almost absent gaze.
sentences.ko: 사라는 무심하다 못해 넋 나간 듯한 눈빛의 얼굴을 그려요.

sentences.text: Le pain de mie industriel est tout juste acceptable, selon Antoine.
sentences.en: Factory sliced bread is barely acceptable, according to Antoine.
sentences.ko: 앙투안 말로는 공장 식빵은 겨우 봐줄 만한 수준이에요.

sentences.text: Le premier croquis de Sarah est acceptable, mais elle veut faire mieux.
sentences.en: Sarah's first sketch is acceptable, but she wants to do better.
sentences.ko: 사라의 첫 스케치는 괜찮은 편이지만 사라는 더 잘하고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Il ne faut pas se méprendre : Antoine adore son métier malgré les nuits courtes.
sentences.en: Make no mistake: Antoine loves his job despite the short nights.
sentences.ko: 오해하지 마세요. 앙투안은 잠이 모자라도 자기 일을 정말 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Sarah s'est méprise sur l'intention du peintre en lisant le titre du tableau.
sentences.en: Sarah misunderstood the painter's intention when she read the painting's title.
sentences.ko: 사라는 그림 제목을 읽고 화가의 의도를 잘못 이해했어요.

sentences.text: Antoine dit avec franchise à son apprenti que sa pâte est trop sèche.
sentences.en: Antoine tells his apprentice frankly that his dough is too dry.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 견습생에게 반죽이 너무 말랐다고 솔직하게 말해요.

sentences.text: Sarah apprécie la franchise de la prof, même quand ça fait mal.
sentences.en: Sarah appreciates the teacher's frankness, even when it hurts.
sentences.ko: 사라는 아플 때가 있어도 선생님의 솔직함이 좋아요.

sentences.text: Antoine attend que la croûte soit bien dorée avant de sortir le pain.
sentences.en: Antoine waits until the crust is nicely golden before taking out the bread.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 빵 껍질이 노릇노릇해질 때까지 기다렸다가 꺼내요.

sentences.text: Sarah ajoute une touche de peinture dorée sur le cadre.
sentences.en: Sarah adds a touch of gold paint to the frame.
sentences.ko: 사라는 액자에 금색 물감을 살짝 칠해요.

sentences.text: Cette année, Antoine espère surpasser son record de galettes des rois vendues.
sentences.en: This year, Antoine hopes to beat his record for king cakes sold.
sentences.ko: 올해 앙투안은 갈레트 데 루아 판매 기록을 넘어서길 바라요.

sentences.text: Sarah espère un jour surpasser sa prof en aquarelle.
sentences.en: Sarah hopes to surpass her teacher at watercolour one day.
sentences.ko: 사라는 언젠가 수채화로 선생님을 뛰어넘고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Le jury du concours de la meilleure baguette est impitoyable, prévient Antoine.
sentences.en: The jury of the best baguette contest is ruthless, Antoine warns.
